description: List the canonical Homecastr data-asset catalog across public, metadata-only, restricted, and unavailable rows. Use this to discover the full standardized surface, not just currently launched endpoints.

data_family.description: Optional family filter such as 'forecast_output', 'input_panel', 'source_metadata', or 'provenance_manifest'.

inventory_asset.description: Optional public-data inventory asset filter such as 'forecast.aggregate_surfaces' or 'benchmark.normalized_training_panels_candidate'.

public_status.description: Optional public status filter such as 'launch', 'draft', 'metadata_only', 'hold', or 'not_public'.

visibility.description: Optional visibility filter such as 'public', 'metadata_only', 'restricted', or 'unavailable'.

name: list_data_assets

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: List Data Assets
